name: Dracodrone
biography: Modronos draconis. A modron-made dragon of perfect order — every ability score exactly 20, no Advantage or Disadvantage permitted near it, and a reaction that flattens any die roll to a perfectly average 10. Habitat: Extraplanar.

features.name: Cold Order
features.description: At the end of each of the dracodrone's turns, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the dracodrone takes 5 Cold damage and can't gain Advantage or Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the end of the dracodrone's next turn.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If the dracodrone fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Low Variance
features.description: The dracodrone can't gain Advantage or Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The dracodrone makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage. Saving Throw: DC 19 Constitution, a creature hit by this attack. Failure: The target is frozen and is Paralysed until the end of its next turn or until it takes Fire damage.

features.name: Claw
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage.

features.name: Frost Breath (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 19 Constitution, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 55 (10d10) Cold damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target is frozen and is Paralysed until the end of its next turn or until it takes Fire damage. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Zero Out
features.description: Trigger: A creature within 60 feet of the dracodrone makes a D20 Test. Response: The dracodrone adjusts for all possible variables. The result of the roll is 10 (before applying any modifiers).

features.name: Frost Layer (Legendary Action)
features.description:
Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the dracodrone can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dracodrone regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

The dracodrone covers itself in a protective layer of frost until the start of its next turn or until it takes Fire damage. While the dracodrone has this protective layer, each instance of damage it takes is reduced by 10.

features.name: Move (Legendary Action)
features.description: The dracodrone moves up to its Speed.
